reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Since August 2026, Lakeside Water's CRM dispute ticket volume has roughly doubled (E-02: ~600/month Jun-Jul to 1180-1260/month Aug-Sep), driven primarily by a change to the billing import validation rules around that time that produced incorrect bill calculations/estimate substitutions on bills regardless of read type — not by CS response-time capacity (ruled out: E-01 shows response within SLA) or a tariff change (ruled out: E-05, corroborated E-07). E-04 shows 59% of disputed bills (1785/3025) are built on ACTUAL reads, so estimate substitution alone (from AMI delivery issues or the manual-read route shortfall, E-03) explains only a minority of disputes and cannot be the primary mechanism.
